Author: NightmareXIV
Name: Stylist
Description: Gear manager that will watch your gearset for possible upgrades and upgrade them via single command.
Changelog: Validated fork update from source 70cf2594715726ad937198c454f84192eb95bcd3. Storage sorting compares base item IDs across all saved sets, ignoring quality and appearance differences. Stops if gearset membership changes during sorting to prevent reversing earlier moves. Logs membership and move decisions for diagnosis. Uses the original Stylist emblem recoloured in the fork-family green-to-magenta palette. Build, storage, merge-policy and package checks passed. Existing IPC identity is preserved. Development preview; native UI acceptance testing remains separate.
